VA-S.note: AP called the race for Warner; Fox 5 DC published the call at 7:03 p.m. ET and WDBJ7 at 7:13 p.m. No statewide count was readable from this run.

GA-S.note: NBC News and Decision Desk HQ projected Ossoff the winner at about 25% of the expected vote; an AP call could not be verified by this run, so the desk shows no call.

SC-S.note: Early returns reflecting a small share of the vote; AP had not called the race as of 7:23 p.m. ET.

SC-G.note: Early returns reflecting a small share of the vote; AP had not called the race as of 7:23 p.m. ET.

alerts.text: AP calls the Virginia Senate race for Mark Warner
